messages:
maria-sales: Quick sync 5 ZenBridge wants to start a 2-week POC. Legal says they need SOC 2 artifacts, ISO cert copy, and a signed pen-test attestation before giving staging access. Can we deliver this week?

josh-se: I can pull the SOC 2 summary + control matrix excerpt we usually give for POCs. Need confirmation on what to redact (user identifiers / vendor names).

rebecca-security: We can provide the SOC 2 Type II summary and redacted control matrix. For the full SOC 2 report we require an NDA + secure transfer. ISO certificate PDF is fine to share.

sam-ps: ZenBridge specifically requested a pen-test letter with a named signatory for their procurement vendor. Do we have a standard attestation template I can send?

rebecca-security: Yes. Our standard: "Redwood Inference confirms a third-party penetration test was completed on YYYY-MM and there were no critical open findings at the time of testing." We do not share raw pentest findings by default; we provide a signed attestation instead.

audits-bot: action: create presigned-s3 (expiry 7d) for artifact delivery 5 created by devex 5 link DM'd to maria-sales (link hidden).

maria-sales: ZenBridge also needs confirmation EU data residency (eu-west-1) for the POC. Can we promise that on Hosted for a short trial or do we need Dedicated/Private? Pricing will be a blocker.

josh-se: For a short POC we can host in eu-west-1 on Hosted but isolated with a VPC bridge (private deployment feel). That incurs a delta. Quick estimate: ~1.6x of baseline for reserved capacity for 2 weeks. I'll send formal delta tomorrow.

sam-ps: For the pen-test signatory, rebecca 5 can you sign as Director of Security? Procurement prefers a CISO title but Director is usually accepted. If they require CISO, legal escalation needed.

rebecca-security: I can sign as Director of Security and include a contact email. If they insist on CISO, legal will need to route to execs which could add time.

maria-sales: They also asked about KMS separation and live auditor access windows. Any quick answers?

josh-se: KMS: in Dedicated/Private we can give customer-managed keys. On Hosted we use ephemeral keys; we can show key flow diagrams. If they want KMS-segregation for the POC, we need ~72h ops lead time to provision.

rebecca-security: Audit access: we can provide a read-only evidence bundle and schedule a 2-hr walkthrough with a security engineer. For direct auditor system access (SSO accounts) we need signed terms + 5 business days to provision.

maria-sales: Next steps: 1) rebecca - share signed pen-test attestation on presigned link TODAY, 2) devex - upload ISO cert + SOC2 summary to presigned link TODAY, 3) josh - send eu-west pricing delta + KMS lead time TOMORROW, 4) sam - propose audit walkthrough slot and own scheduling.

rebecca-security: I'll attach signed attestation to the presigned link and include contact details.

devex: Presigned link created and DM'd to Maria. Reminder: do not paste presigned links in public channels :lock:

sam-ps: Scheduling hold placed for audit walkthrough 5 proposing Wed 10:00 UTC, will confirm with ZenBridge.

maria-sales: Great, I'll tell ZenBridge we can deliver attestation and certs today and clarify regional pricing tomorrow. :thumbsup:
